geodetic_origin.task_frame: local tangent NED; N=ENU y, E=ENU x

navsat_validity.decision: fix_valid=1 only when latitude and longitude are finite and the conditioned sample timestamp is within the GPS freshness window; otherwise zero-fill with fix_valid=0
navsat_validity.native_constraint: gz.msgs.NavSat has no explicit status field
navsat_validity.equivalence: finite output supplies native validity; shared observation freshness supplies bcod-sim-equivalent stale/invalid behavior

live_local_coordinate_check.interpretation: Includes configured 0.8 m/axis noise, 0.2 s latency, and vessel motion during latency; privileged position is comparison-only.

conversion.sensor_path: external_sensor_model.py flu_to_body_ned and quaternion_to_ned_yaw, the same functions imported by vrx_trace_exporter.py

notes: The phaseASensors=true task-world path was already enabled before this gate; the geodetic-origin generator change is independently tested. No generated golden checksum was silently rewritten.
